name: Open WebUI Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free self-hosted browser interface for local and OpenAI-compatible AI models; no vendor-imposed usage quota when running the software with required branding intact.
watch_out: Current Open WebUI License (v0.6.6+) is source-available, not OSI-approved: keep Open WebUI branding intact unless the documented <=50-user exception or explicit permission/license applies. Hosting, model inference and third-party API costs are separate.
